_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Fifty-second scheduled run. NO NEW FINDINGS: zero matches without an existing case across 10,473 product pages on 16 serving URLs. A quiet, uneventful run, which after the 43-case day of 2026-11-19 is the expected steady state. Your Roses served normally for a second consecutive day since its 2026-11-20 blackout. Nothing returned to any feed today -- reverify_cases.py printed no RETURNED section, its first run since that reporting was added on 2026-11-23. Xavian's Roses was refused for a FOURTH consecutive run and 9 cases went unchecked. ERGONZI IS NOW A PATTERN, NOT A ONE-OFF: its scheduled pull was reset by peer for the third time in five runs (2026-11-19, 11-23, 11-24) and served in full on a single re-pull each time. It has never been a genuine coverage gap, but the first connection of the morning failing and the second succeeding is consistent enough to be worth naming rather than retrying silently.
